metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace of the chums-baibot skill: install and manage Chums baibot instances.

plugins.name: chums-baibot
plugins.description: Deploy and operate Chums baibot instances: the Matrix LLM bot with billing and x402 top-ups (bot container + payment sidecar) on a local or ssh-reachable Docker host. Use when the user asks to install, deploy, configure, update, restart, back up, inspect, health-check, read the logs of or remove a matrix bot, tron bot, chums bot or baibot.
